race.comment: QUILLAN (10) overcame a slow start to work home well and be beaten just two lengths when resuming over 1000m here last start. Sure to be far more influential over this longer journey. Will settle back from a wide alley but watch for a big final split. JOAN'S THUNDER (13) made a wide run on the corner and kept digging deep to be beaten under a length on debut over 1000m at this circuit. Awkwardly drawn but ideally placed over a bit more ground today. Will prove tough to hold out. SHE'S ICONNIC (12) raced handy all the way only to be beaten in a photo when resuming over 1100m at Gawler ten days ago. Likely improver with each-way claims. EXPEEARE (3) has been finishing thereabouts but has found a couple handy maiden winners. Draws well for Stubby and is worth keeping onside.
